answer.reason: The verses only list Hakkoz as the seventh priestly course and as an ancestor whose descendants lacked a register, which the summary already says, and the building work in Nehemiah 3 is done by his grandson.
doubts: Koz in EZR 2:61, NEH 7:63 and NEH 3:4,21 is assumed to be the same as Hakkoz; the marked verses do not say so.
